en: Vintage black‑and‑white postcard showing an early 20th‑century brick industrial building with a tiled roof, likely a rural machine factory and smithy. In front of the long building are several large agricultural machines and wheels on display, with workers or owners posing among them. Trees line the facade. A caption panel at the bottom identifies the factory, and additional text appears on a machine at the right.
